packageRules.description: Lock file maintenance regenerates mise.lock without the idiomatic rust-toolchain.toml entry (rust via idiomatic_version_file_enable_tools), so CI fails with 'rust@1.98.0 is not in the lockfile'. mise.lock is maintained manually via `mise lock`. See PRs #155, #157, #159.

Velnor strict slots (capability manifest v9) accept only the reviewed setup-mold SHA 9c9c13bf; unreviewed digest bumps are rejected with capability_validation and break Velnor-lane builds. Bump only after fleet review lands.
